experiments.label: M7
experiments.title: Training-bank controls and aligned future supervision
experiments.hypothesis: Aligning auxiliary targets to the forecast horizon may improve trajectory and event skill without new predictors.
experiments.method: Four training-side CV splits; retrain both prior controls. Four controlled future-supervision losses with identical data, architecture, seeds and fixed epochs.
experiments.success_criteria: Beat both controls on all four training-side metrics: at least 1% RMSE reduction, +0.005 Fisher r, 0.5% chi-square reduction, and +0.02 HSE threat score.
experiments.observation: No aligned-target condition passed. Some lowered chi-square, but RMSE, correlation and HSE threat score failed the balanced gate.

experiments.label: M8
experiments.title: Fixed mixtures, feature ablations and four-metric calibration
experiments.hypothesis: Diverse supervision and spatial image features may complement one another and yield a balanced four-metric gain.
experiments.method: 24 fixed bases and 49 amplitude/bias settings each; 1,176 training-bank configurations. Same rows, images and folds; both prior controls retained.
experiments.success_criteria: Beat both controls on every metric using the predeclared margins. No single-metric adoption.
experiments.observation: No configuration passed all four requirements. Gate pass counts: RMSE 139, r 0, chi-square 410, HSE threat score 244 of 1176; no model adopted.

experiments.label: M9
experiments.title: Location-preserving pretrained feature maps and weighted ridge ablations
experiments.hypothesis: Local pretrained activation energies may retain solar-disk geometry that global pooling loses, improving the training-side correlation ceiling.
experiments.method: Two fixed 4x4 spatial representations, three temporal views, five ridge penalties, two fitting weights; 60 raw recipes plus 2880 fixed mixtures/calibrations. Same original images and rows.
experiments.success_criteria: Beat both controls on all four metrics using the preregistered margins, then pass a training-only stability check.
experiments.observation: One of 2940 configurations passed all four training-side gates: RMSE78.55, Fisher r0.567, chi-square27.02, HSE_TS0.280. The event gain has positive conditional intervals against both controls; other gains remain uncertain versus priorM6. Stability must be checked before freeze. Subsequent preregistered stability screen passed only2/4 leave-one-fold-out checks, so this isolated candidate was not frozen.

experiments.label: M10
experiments.title: Variance-weight sensitivity and stability of location-preserving forecasting
experiments.hypothesis: Fit-side precision weights may improve balanced margins and make the isolated M9 validation pass stable across training folds.
experiments.method: 45 raw location ridge recipes and 3600 mixtures/calibrations, same images and rows. Require all four gates, 3/4 directional leave-one-fold-out passes, no fold RMSE loss above5%, and positive HSE bootstrap bounds against both controls. Audit M9 with the same stability rule.
experiments.success_criteria: Strict four-metric gate plus preregistered stability; select the lowest RMSE eligible candidate. No test scoring.
experiments.observation: 50of3645 strict four-metric passes;31pass fold stability. Seven candidates rejected for uncertain event intervals; the eighth qualifies: RMSE78.00, Fisher r0.574, chi-square26.56, HSE_TS0.249. Positive event-score intervals against both controls and3/4 fold-stability checks. Recovered controls and row audits exactly match originals. Operational failures retained.

experiments.label: F2
experiments.title: Frozen stability-qualified location model on original WindNet folds
experiments.hypothesis: The training-only stability-qualified M10 primary may improve all four original metrics on identical historical windows.
experiments.method: Freeze all scientific sources, recipes, epochs and data identities; then one original five-fold pass with seven fixed models/ablations plus released WindNet. Fit all before scores are exported. No label access by estimators or post-test model replacement.
experiments.success_criteria: Strictly lower mean-fold RMSE and reduced chi-square, higher Fisher-z correlation and mean original HSE threat score versus released WindNet on2198identicalwindows. Undefined fails.
